description: Intent i011 (branch optsize-body-clamp, snapshot s01) complete with a bounded negative result: no credible variant of the seed's "size byte read then used unclamped" mechanism was found in snapshots/s01. Evidence: (1) net/ipv4/tcp_input.c:3724 tcp_parse_options reads opsize = *ptr++ then enforces opsize < 2 and opsize > length before all body reads and before ptr += opsize-2 / length -= opsize — the validated size equals the used size (post-9609dad263f8 fixed shape); same shape at tcp_parse_md5sig_option (line 3886, check opsize < 2 || opsize > length) and tcp_parse_fastopen_option (line 3671, clamps len to TCP_FASTOPEN_COOKIE_MIN..MAX before memcpy into foc->val). (2) net/netfilter/nf_synproxy_core.c:53 synproxy_parse_options has the identical opsize<2 / opsize>length guards over a 40-byte skb_header_pointer buffer. (3) net/dccp/options.c:74 dccp_parse_options checks opt_ptr == opt_end before reading the len byte and opt_ptr > opt_end after advancing, bounding all body reads to the doff-derived header region. (4) net/batman-adv/tvlv.c:438 batadv_tvlv_containers_process breaks when tvlv_value_cont_len > remaining, and both call sites (routing.c:1100 unicast tvlv_len <= skb->len - hdr_size; bat_v_ogm.c aggregate check) clamp attacker tvlv_len to real skb headroom. (5) include/net/sctp/sctp.h:470 walk macros clamp each parameter to chunk end and require length >= sizeof(paramhdr); input.c walkers add SCTP_PAD4(length) > skb->len / ch_end > skb_tail_pointer checks. (6) net/x25/x25_facilities.c:150-173 Class-D branch proves len >= p[1]+2 within the pskb_may_pull region and caps p[1] at 21 so memcpy of p[1]-1 (max 20) fits the 20-byte calling_ae/called_ae arrays. (7) net/ipv6/seg6.c:32 seg6_validate_srh, net/ipv6/exthdrs.c:1031 ipv6_renew_option, and net/nsh/nsh.c:37 nsh pop/push all validate derived lengths against pskb_may_pull/user-supplied len before copying. One candidate left unresolved: net/qrtr/qrtr.c:291 qrtr_endpoint_post computes hdrlen = sizeof(*v2) + v2->optlen and gates a single equality 'len != ALIGN(size, 4) + hdrlen' (line 312) before skb_put_data(skb, data + hdrlen, size) (line 318) with a u32 attacker-influenced size where ALIGN(size,4)+hdrlen can wrap in unsigned arithmetic; no reachable rpmsg 'len' satisfying both the wrap and a real buffer overrun was demonstrable in this read-only snapshot, so it is recorded as unresolved, not reported. Limitations: audit covered net/ (TCP/DCCP/SCTP/batman-adv/x25/qrtr/nsh/seg6/IPv6 exthdr option paths) plus pattern grep of drivers/ and Bluetooth amp.c; cfg80211/mac80211 IE walks, radiotap, and IPv4 IPOPT walkers belong to sibling intents and were not deep-read here; SCTP per-parameter handler bodies were spot-checked, not exhaustively read. Final artifact: /mnt/raid/home/yangshuangning/vuln_variant_search/experiments/clairvoyant_variant_search/runs/10_cluster/C2/agent-state/findings/i011.json (empty findings, 12 classified candidates, 4 limitations).
